code-review: passed → 通过（通过）
The code passes. apps/web/convex has only two places that call sendEmail (the shared helper in convex/email.ts, which sends through SES or the Specode relay). The first is deliverSignInOtp in convex/lib/emailOtpAuth.ts:40. It receives only {email, otp, type} and refuses any type other than "sign-in". Its subject is "Your Round Companion sign-in code". The body holds only the code, the line "It expires in 5 minutes." and the line "If you did not request this code, you can ignore this email." It has no name, room, MRN, diagnosis or link. The second is sendResetPassword in convex/auth_provider_extension.ts:21, the generated migration hook. It is switched off: convex/auth.ts spreads ...emailOtpAuthOptions after ...migrationAuth.options, so emailAndPassword becomes { enabled: false }, and disabledPaths blocks the password reset routes (/request-password-reset, /reset-password, /forget-password/email-otp, /email-otp/reset-password and others). The plugin list is the empty migration plugins, emailOTP, convex and crossDomain, and none of these sends any other email. A grep found no third place that sends email. The scenario defers to no open question and touches no recorded gap. Whether a code-only email is acceptable (Q9) and whether delivery uses TLS (S22) are outside this verdict.

思路 / Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S14 「登录码邮件是代码唯一能发的邮件，它的模板不带病人数据」 The sign-in code email is the only email the code can send, and its template carries no patient data

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 No email or mailto that carries patient data, on any screen that shows patient data, in Hospital and in Nursing Home: no PHI is transmitted through an unencrypted path. …（UAT OAT-02 step 3；UAT OAT-02；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given convex/ at the UAT commit

When List every sendEmail call site and read the sign-in code template and its inputs.

Then Exactly two call sites: convex/lib/emailOtpAuth.ts:40 (deliverSignInOtp, input {email, otp, type}) and convex/auth_provider_extension.ts:21 (sendResetPassword), which is disabled because emailOtpAuthOptions spreads after it in convex/auth.ts (email and password off, reset paths in disabledPaths). …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-02 step 3 'nothing PHI-bearing exits through an unencrypted channel … (no email, in app only)'. Code, expiry and ignore line only; no name, room, MRN, diagnosis or link. A third call site, a template input beyond {email, otp, type}, or the reset path enabled = Fail. That a code-only email is acceptable is Q9.

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

Detail:

The code passes. apps/web/convex has only two places that call sendEmail (the shared helper in convex/email.ts, which sends through SES or the Specode relay). The first is deliverSignInOtp in convex/lib/emailOtpAuth.ts:40. It receives only {email, otp, type} and refuses any type other than "sign-in". Its subject is "Your Round Companion sign-in code". The body holds only the code, the line "It expires in 5 minutes." and the line "If you did not request this code, you can ignore this email." It has no name, room, MRN, diagnosis or link. The second is sendResetPassword in convex/auth_provider_extension.ts:21, the generated migration hook. It is switched off: convex/auth.ts spreads ...emailOtpAuthOptions after ...migrationAuth.options, so emailAndPassword becomes { enabled: false }, and disabledPaths blocks the password reset routes (/request-password-reset, /reset-password, /forget-password/email-otp, /email-otp/reset-password and others). The plugin list is the empty migration plugins, emailOTP, convex and crossDomain, and none of these sends any other email. A grep found no third place that sends email. The scenario defers to no open question and touches no recorded gap. Whether a code-only email is acceptable (Q9) and whether delivery uses TLS (S22) are outside this verdict.

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • Q9 (whether a code-only sign-in email is acceptable) does not decide this verdict.
  • The scenario's Then and the question agree; I found no difference between them.
  • Q9: whether a code-only sign-in email is acceptable is left to Q9 and does not affect this verdict.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • Whether the email is delivered over TLS (S22, CONFIG): which provider runs in production (AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER=ses or SPECODE_EMAIL_MODE=platform) is set by the environment.
  • Whether better-auth's runtime really drops the replaced sendResetPassword and honours disabledPaths depends on the library's behaviour, not on this repository.
  • Whether email is delivered over TLS (S22, a configuration check).
  • Whether the deployed environment variables (AUTH_EMAIL_PROVIDER / SPECODE_EMAIL_MODE) choose SES or the relay in production.

审查结论（verdict）：pass
